vibe: Deterministic task runners, disciplined formatting, and modular consistency.
highlights: A file for [guiding coding agents](https://agents.md/). Kopuz is a Rust + Dioxus
music player; one Cargo workspace holds the daemon and its frontends, laid out by
layer under `shared/`, `daemon/` and `apps/` (see Directory Structure). See
assessment: Standard operational configuration for agentic pair programming.
